The automation platform debate just got interesting in 2026.

After analyzing costs, features, and real-world ROI, here's what the data shows:

Make (formerly Integromat) delivers 10x more operations per dollar than Zapier. For businesses running high-volume automation—think 10,000+ tasks monthly—this cost difference is staggering. We're talking hundreds to thousands in monthly savings.

But here's the nuance: Zapier remains the superior choice for non-technical teams who prioritize ease of use over complexity. Its intuitive interface means faster implementation and less training time.

The real question isn't "which is better?" It's "which aligns with YOUR priorities?"

• Choose Make if: You have technical resources and need to scale cost-effectively
• Choose Zapier if: Speed to value and user-friendliness matter more than per-task costs

I've broken down the complete pricing structures, feature comparisons, and ROI calculations to help you make the right choice for your business.
